name: How can I improve the lighting in a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How can I improve the lighting in a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: To improve lighting in a small bathroom, focus on maximizing light output and creating an illusion of space. Consider bright, even illumination with recessed lights and a well-placed vanity light. Mirrored surfaces and light-colored finishes also help reflect light. A practical tradeoff to consider is between adding numerous fixtures, which can feel cluttered, versus selecting fewer, more powerful, and strategically placed lights that serve multiple purposes without overwhelming the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Improve small bathroom lighting with bright, even illumination from recessed and vanity lights. Consider the tradeoff between many fixtures and fewer, powerful, well-placed lights.
